notes.title: September Patch 1.2 (Mini Fix)
notes.notes:
Characters

 Cap no longer visible from player’s perspective
 Walk / Run backwards adjusted


Gameplay

 Version 1 of new maggot hive mesh
 Camera is now a bit smoother when walking / running
 Some NPC’s should now work better and not jitter around

notes.title: September Patch 1
notes.notes:
GUI
- Fixed 'Escape' for going back and exiting menus (in addition to backspace)
- Toggleable HUD (experimental) with ‘H’
- HUD has working hotbar showing current equipment, consumables and lightsource (will be customizable)
- Added some gameplay and graphics options. Resolution should now be recognized.
- The ‘Main Menu’ app is now called menu and will be the starting page in the lobby screen in the next patch and ‘Apps’ (currently the starting page) as a button option.
- Increased sizes of button ‘hitboxes’ for the phone’s back and home symbols.

Inventory
- Updated equipment interaction and combat
- Setup collectibles and placed a couple of tests (added to the bookshelf on pickup)
- Implemented Crafting Table (experimental)

Characters
- Massively updated Jarl character (model, textures, rig and some animations)
- Updated the cutscene player character to match a recently upgraded model (arm mutation in particular has changed a lot)
- A couple of crucial characters never spawned, should be fixed.
- One character was always talkable. Now turned off.

Gameplay
- Improved intro tasks
- Certain quest and other crucial items should now be easier to spot (experimental)
- Stronger handlight and better equippable lantern (now also stored in inventory)
- Updated Ratcrow cutscene after recent studyroom change
- Lightsource toggle is temporarily changed from L to F (flashlight)
- Adjusted some interactables to not show interactable glow and should now become orange if they’re not interactable quite yet.
- Added punching to mousebutton 1 (action button later in the game)
- Bed was interactable at all times and should now only be interactable if the day’s requirements are fulfilled
- Temporarily made the phone cutscene in Night 1 skippable
- Changed the second jump mechanic. Instant second jump is reduced in power rather than not being triggered at all (‘tired’ delay is also reduced)

Audio
- Audio adjustment in progress after feedback that the master volume is too low. Temporary, when the master slider is adjusted the volume is multiplied by 3.
